_comment: The delivery board, described once. scripts/setup_project.py applies it.
Sanitised from the HotelRooms board (ai-gmented-pm/hotelrooms, Le Wagon
certification, Bloc 2), which proved the shape on a four-developer team.
Edit this file, re-run the script: it creates what is missing and never
deletes. A field or a view is matched BY NAME, so renaming one here
creates a second one on the board instead of renaming the first.
What the API cannot set, and stays manual (docs/BOARD.md): the built-in
workflows, the grouping and the sorting of a view, and the two date
title: {{PROJECT_NAME}} — livraison
short_description: Delivery board of {{PROJECT_NAME}}: one item per user story, the seven statuses of the method.

status.name: Backlog
status.description: Opened by the agent, label « à revoir par Romain »

status.name: Ready
status.description: Romain alone puts a story here

status.name: In progress
status.description: The agent, when it opens the worktree

status.name: En recette
status.description: Branch merged into recette, every test green

status.name: À déployer
status.description: Set by the board workflow, on merge

fields.name: MoSCoW
fields.why: What ships if time runs out. Named MoSCoW and not « Priorité » on purpose: a view filter addresses a field by its name in lowercase, and moscow: has no accent to get wrong.

options.name: Must have
options.description: The release is worthless without it

options.name: Won't have
options.description: Decided out of this release, kept for the record

fields.name: Phase
fields.why: The stretch of the project a story belongs to. These options are placeholders — rename them to the project's own phases before the first story.

options.name: 1 · Walking skeleton
options.description: One thin slice deployed end to end

options.name: 2 · Core flow
options.description: The feature the product exists for

fields.name: Sprint
fields.why: Iterations, so the Current sprint view can filter on sprint:@current and never be edited again.

fields.name: Estimate
fields.why: Story points. Only useful once a few sprints give it a scale — leave it empty until then.

fields.name: Start date
fields.why: Left in English, and paired with Target date, because the Roadmap layout is configured on two date fields and these are the names it offers first.

views.name: Kanban
views.why: Where the work stands. A board view created by the API is already grouped by Status; Status is therefore left out of the card.

views.name: À revoir par Romain
views.why: Romain's own queue: what the agent opened and nobody has moved to Ready.

views.name: Current sprint
views.why: @current follows the iterations on its own — no filter to edit at each sprint.

views.name: Prioritized backlog
views.why: What is left to do, worst first. Group it by MoSCoW by hand: the API does not set a grouping.

views.name: Roadmap
views.why: One milestone per release, side by side. A roadmap view refuses visible fields — its columns are its two date fields, and they are set by hand, like its grouping.

views.name: Epics
views.why: Epic → story → task. Group it by Parent issue by hand.

views.name: Defects
views.why: The agent's own failures, apart from the product's bugs (docs/DEFECTS.md).

views.name: Blocked
views.why: The board has no Blocked status: without this view a blocked story looks exactly like work in progress.

views.name: All items
views.why: Everything, nothing hidden. GitHub's own first view, renamed.
